name: GLIMPSE-C02 (Hubble)
blurb: GLIMPSE-C02, a dust-shrouded globular cluster in the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: glimpsec02-hubble
story: Deeply embedded in dust where the Milky Way's thin disk meets its central bulge, GLIMPSE-C02 is a globular cluster among the most metal-rich in the galaxy. Hubble looked here as part of its first view of some of the Milky Way's most heavily obscured globular clusters.

claims.text: GLIMPSE-C02 (G02) is a Milky Way globular cluster
It is among the most metal-rich globular clusters in the Galaxy
It is deeply embedded in dust
It lies at the inner edge of the thin disk, in the transition region with the bulge
Hubble program 17918 is a first view of extremely obscured Galactic globular clusters, including GLIMPSE-C02
